career_ladder.note: Junior Engineers in Madhya Pradesh Power Generating Company Limited (MPPGCL) are inducted as Trainees into the technical cadre across thermal and hydel power stations (such as SGTPS Birsinghpur, STPS Sarni, ATPS Chachai, and SSTPP Khandwa). After completing one year of training and a three-year probation period (including training), they receive two advance increments as personal pay and advance through departmental promotion committees (DPC) and qualifying benchmarks into executive engineering leadership.

steps.source_label: MPPGCL Engineering Cadre Service Regulations & Promotion Quota

exam_scheme.note: Selection is conducted via a single-stage Computer Based Test (CBT) of 100 objective multiple-choice questions across 120 minutes with zero negative marking. Candidates who clear category-wise minimum qualifying thresholds (40% for UR, 30% for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD) are ranked on a normalized merit list for Document Verification.

stages.source_label: MPPGCL Direct Recruitment Rulebook (Advt. No. 4811/2025-26, Section 6)

papers.negative_marking: No negative marking (गलत उत्तर का नकारात्मक अंकन नहीं होगा)

papers.paper_name: Part B — General Knowledge, General Aptitude, Reasoning & Basic Computer Awareness
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking (गलत उत्तर का नकारात्मक अंकन नहीं होगा)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 40% aggregate marks for Unreserved (UR) candidates; 30% aggregate marks for SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), EWS, and PwD candidates

papers.paper_name: Scrutiny of Engineering Diploma / Degree Credentials, MP Domicile, Age Proof & Category Certificates
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying verification of original academic, domicile, and reservation documents

financial_package.note: Junior Engineers are appointed in Pay Level 8 of the Madhya Pradesh Power Sector Revised Pay Matrix (pay scale ₹32,800–₹1,03,600 with an entry basic pay of ₹32,800). During the initial one-year training period, candidates receive a consolidated stipend equal to the minimum of the scale (₹32,800). Upon successful completion of training and absorption into regular service, appointees receive two advance increments as personal pay.
financial_package.pay_source_label: MPPGCL Direct Recruitment Rulebook (Advt. No. 4811/2025-26, Clause 9 & 11)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 8 entry basic pay of ₹32,800 at 58% DA (effective 01.07.2025), House Rent Allowance (₹2,624 to ₹5,248 depending on posting in Bhopal/Jabalpur/Indore or company residential colony at thermal/hydel generating stations), plant operation allowance, net of 10% NPS deduction (₹5,182), professional tax (₹208), and employee group insurance.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised semi-annually per Madhya Pradesh state power sector notifications
Company township residential accommodation at Thermal/Hydel generating stations (SGTPS Birsinghpur, STPS Sarni, ATPS Chachai, SSTPP Khandwa) or House Rent Allowance (HRA)
Plant operation / shift duty allowance for operational staff
Medical reimbursement facilities under MPPGCL Medical Attendance Rules
Contributory Pension Scheme (NPS) with 14% matching employer contribution
Subsidized electricity concession per MPPGCL employee service regulations
Two advance increments granted as personal pay upon successful completion of 1-year training
Leave Travel Concession (LTC), Gratuity, and Group Insurance scheme coverage
